title: Template: study v2's final model (A0)
description: Copy this file to start a new experiment: save it as EXPERIMENTS/configs/<new id>.json, set "id" to the same name, change "title", "description" and the values under "changes". As it stands it trains study v2's final model A0: active torque, EMG envelopes (forward-only filters) scaled by their session-1 training maximum, one LSTM layer of 64 units whose state is carried through each trial (trained in chunks of 200 samples = 2 s), trained on session 1 and tested on session 2. Run one person and seed with: python -m EXPERIMENTS.pipeline.run --exp TEMPLATE_reference --subject EG --seed 0. Predictions are written to EXPERIMENTS/results/<id>/<person>/S1toS2/seed<k>.npz with the full settings in the matching .json. Settings not listed under "changes" take the defaults in BASE (EXPERIMENTS/pipeline/settings.py), which also lists the values each setting may take. The fixed processing (filters, trims, EMG scaling, training schedule) is in ML/config.py and ML/README.md.

settings_help.model: 'lstm' = the LSTM (ML/models/lstm.py, or ML/research/stateful.py with state 'carry'); 'ridge_lagged' = ridge regression on lagged envelopes (ML/models/baselines.py)
settings_help.passive: target: 'static' = measured torque minus the passive torque of the same session's relaxed holds (active torque); 'none' = total measured torque
settings_help.window: time steps per input window (one step = 10 ms, so 20 = 200 ms). With state 'carry' it sets the samples at the start of each trial that are not scored
settings_help.state: 'reset' = LSTM state reset at every window; 'carry' = state carried through the whole trial
settings_help.chunk: state 'carry' only: samples per training chunk (null = window)
settings_help.batch: windows per batch, state 'reset' only (null = 64, ML/config.py TRAINING)
